description:
We are a team of six: two biotechnology students, CS students and full-stack developers, and some of us work full time. We share one goal: to understand why the weather is getting harsher for people in Pakistan, using real NASA data instead of guesses.

What we are working on

Karachi, Pakistan’s largest city and economic hub, is reported to be getting hotter, with less rain. Lahore and Delhi are among the most polluted cities in the world. We are figuring out its causes using NASA's dataset.
